SH-01.description: Login screen accepts bearer token, validates via GET /health/ready, decodes JWT, navigates on success, shows error on failure

SH-02.description: Session expiry triggers redirect to /login?reason=session-expired with banner

SH-03.description: Role-filtered navigation: items outside user's permissions hidden entirely

SH-04.description: User display_name and roles shown in shell header; logout clears session and redirects to /login

notes: TC-SH02-01 required a MINOR bug fix during test-runner phase: ProtectedRoute re-render race condition in AuthProvider fixed by replacing navigate() with window.location.replace() for session-expired redirect. Fix is in web/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx. No BLOCKER or CRITICAL issues. ESLint emitted a TypeScript version advisory warning (TS 5.9.3 vs supported <5.6.0) but exit code was 0 and no lint errors found.
